title: CanvasXpress portable figure spec
description: JSON Schema (DRAFT) for the persisted, portable CanvasXpress figure — the {data, config} object emitted by getConfig()/"Save as JSON" and embedded in the self-describing PNG. This is the primary contract users serialize and the surface the CI round-trip guarantee (roadmap #06 6d) must cover. config carries the full parameter vocabulary (hundreds of keys documented in the parameter reference); this schema pins the STRUCTURE and the load-bearing keys, and stays open (additionalProperties) for the long tail rather than freezing every parameter.

schemaVersion.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR of the figure contract. NEW field (roadmap #06 6a); absent in specs written before it is introduced — readers must treat a missing value as the pre-1.0 baseline.

data.description: The wide-matrix data. y is the primary numeric matrix; x annotates samples (columns), z annotates variables (rows). Non-matrix graph types (network, genome, venn, map) carry their own data shapes under this key.
Row-major values: data[i][j] for vars[i] x smps[j].

x.description: Per-sample (column) annotations: annotation name -> array parallel to y.smps.

z.description: Per-variable (row) annotations: annotation name -> array parallel to y.vars.

config.description: Rendering configuration. graphType selects the geometry; the remaining keys are the parameter vocabulary (see https://www.canvasxpress.org/parameters.html). Open by design — unknown keys within a MAJOR line are ignored, not fatal.

graphType.description: The chart type, e.g. Scatter2D, Bar, Line, Heatmap, Boxplot, Violin, Network, Genome, Circular, Venn, Treemap, Meter, OptionsWall.

events.description: Optional event handlers (function bodies serialized by name).

afterRender.description: Optional replayable post-render operation list (the audit-trail seed).
